title: West Palm Beach Events This Week
igCaption:
West Palm Beach has a lantern festival coming up at Mounts Botanical Garden.
It opens November 18 in West Palm Beach, tickets start at $10 for children and $28 for adults.

Sources: Owner request, Miami New Times, The Palm Beach Post

#WestPalmBeach #PalmBeachCounty #SouthFlorida

scenes.text: West Palm Beach has one event on the calendar next, and Mounts Botanical Garden is leading the way.

location.name: Mounts Botanical Garden, West Palm Beach

scenes.text: ILUMINA: A Tropical Garden Lantern Festival opens November 18 at Mounts Botanical Garden. The event runs through January 17, 2027.
scenes.caption: ILUMINA opens November 18 at Mounts Botanical Garden. The event runs through January 17, 2027.

location.name: Mounts Botanical Garden, West Palm Beach

scenes.text: The festival features over 500 handcrafted silk lanterns along illuminated pathways. One of the displays is a 195-foot dragon over the garden’s lake.
scenes.caption: The festival features over 500 handcrafted silk lanterns along illuminated pathways. One display is a 195-foot dragon over the garden’s lake.

location.name: Mounts Botanical Garden, West Palm Beach

scenes.text: Tickets start at $10 for children and $28 for adults. Children under 5 get in free. If you go, open NEAR and see who else showed up for it.

scenes.text: Palm Beach also has a Halloween party on the calendar at Mar-a-Lago. The Palm Beach Post reported Donald Trump returning there for a Halloween party in Palm Beach.
scenes.caption: Palm Beach also has a Halloween party on the calendar at Mar-a-Lago. The Palm Beach Post reported Donald Trump returning there for a Halloween party in Palm Beach.

scenes.text: If you want a West Palm Beach plan, start with the lantern festival. A week full of festivals and stops like this always means passing people you never meet, and NEAR is the app that shows who they were. If you want a Palm Beach Halloween stop, Mar-a-Lago is on the list.
